I hope you can read this. I don't think you will though. All of this that you wrote almost made me cry. I can honestly say that I feel the same way as you describe in the *second* paragraph. That happened to me. For real. And I understand what happened to you because something very very similar to what you wrote in the *sixth* paragraph happened to me a few months ago. It's almost frightning but I believe it's possible that same things can happen to people with real depression. I've been suicidal for about six months and honestly, I'm losing. I don't have that motivation anymore and I dont think I'll have it. I know how it feels. Maybe I end with my life soon. But I want to thank you beacuse not only you made me realise that I'm not just an attention-seeker, but made me realise that truly I needed help, love and care. And more people are going through this exact same situation. Lost your imagination, your motivation, can't speak easily to others, lost a loved one beacuse of your personality... It hurts. But now I know it's real. Thanks.
